title: Warren Commission — Introduction
locator: Commission membership and report transfer paragraphs
supports: Earl Warren chaired the commission; Allen Dulles was a member. The report was submitted September 24, 1964.
limitation: Membership identifies formal roles; it does not by itself settle informal influence or investigative adequacy. The page warns that some collection information may be outdated.

title: Warren Commission Report, Chapter 2
locator: Selection of motorcade route; printed pages 32–40; November 19 newspaper descriptions
supports: Contemporaneous route descriptions reproduced in the report already included the Houston–Elm turns.
limitation: The route excerpts were inspected in the commission transcription, not independently against physical newspaper originals.

title: Executive Order 11110
publisher: John F. Kennedy / American Presidency Project
supports: Delegation of existing presidential authority concerning silver certificates; the text does not abolish or replace the Federal Reserve.
limitation: The order is evidence of its provisions, not of alleged motives for an assassination.

title: National Security Action Memorandum No. 263
publisher: Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State
locator: Document 194, paragraph on 1,000 personnel; signature McGeorge Bundy
supports: Records presidential approval of recommendations and plans to withdraw 1,000 military personnel by the end of 1963.
limitation: This does not establish the counterfactual claim that Kennedy certainly would have ended all U.S. involvement.

title: National Security Action Memorandum No. 273
publisher: Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State
supports: Retains the withdrawal objectives stated in the October 2, 1963 White House statement.
limitation: A statement four days after the assassination does not describe all of Johnson’s later Vietnam policy.

title: House Select Committee on Assassinations — Summary of Findings
publisher: U.S. House of Representatives / U.S. National Archives
locator: Findings I.A–D, especially fatal-shot attribution, probable conspiracy, and investigative inadequacy
supports: The committee reported probable conspiracy but attributed the fatal shot to Oswald and did not identify the other gunman.
limitation: These are the committee’s findings, not an independent reanalysis here. The acoustic foundation was later rejected by the NRC; read S08 with this source.

title: House Select Committee on Assassinations — Introduction
publisher: U.S. House of Representatives / U.S. National Archives
locator: Opening account of Church Committee findings; printed page 9
supports: Documents that the CIA withheld information about U.S. plots against Fidel Castro from the Warren Commission.
limitation: Withholding that information does not establish who ordered Kennedy’s assassination.

title: Report of the Committee on Ballistic Acoustics
locator: Summary, pages 1–2; DOI 10.17226/10264; accessible text at https://nap.nationalacademies.org/skim.php?act=nap&chap=1-2&record_id=10264
supports: Rejected the acoustic basis for the asserted grassy-knoll shot and its 95% probability.
limitation: Rejecting one acoustic analysis is not a proof that every conceivable conspiracy is impossible.

title: JFK Assassination Records — 2025 Documents Release
locator: Release list, including March 18, 2025 and January 30, 2026; June 27, 2025 FBI update
supports: Lists successive document releases and distinguishes remaining grand-jury restrictions in transferred FBI records.
limitation: The title says 2025, but the list also includes 2026. Release is not synonymous with proof of a particular allegation; every released file was not reviewed.

title: Current Status of the JFK Records Collection
publisher: Public Interest Declassification Board blog, hosted by NARA
locator: Main post, paragraph beginning As of March 18, 2025; reader comments excluded
supports: Reports release of the collection’s records previously withheld for classification, with digitization continuing.
limitation: Classification, statutory restrictions, donor restrictions, and online availability are different questions. The post does not authenticate the alleged alternate report.

title: The National Security Archive
publisher: National Security Archive, George Washington University
supports: Describes an independent nongovernmental research institute and library collecting declassified documents.
limitation: The legacy page is used for institutional identity, not a current inventory. It does not establish or disprove every claimed holding.

title: Gunshot-wound dynamics model for John F. Kennedy assassination
supports: Presents a model in which the observed motion is consistent with an impact from behind, including delayed recoil and neuromuscular forces.
limitation: An abstract-level check of a model, not a new forensic reconstruction or proof of all assumptions. PubMed links an October 2018 corrigendum; use corrected material for numerical replication.

title: Configuring a publishing source for your GitHub Pages site
supports: A branch root can serve as the publishing source for the supplied static project.
limitation: Hosting availability depends on account and repository settings. No live repository or deployment is established by this ZIP.

title: Warren Commission Report — Table of Contents
supports: Identifies the public 1964 report and its published structure.
limitation: The existence of the public report does not prove that every investigative record was originally public.
